title: P6 Activity Release 26 cost/EVM typed semantic evidence tranche
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
certification_rule: This artifact certifies only the documented read-side API type and semantic description. Writable/default/nullability/import-export certification is intentionally left open; no Registry identity is changed by this tranche.

fields.description: Sum of actual labor cost and remaining labor cost.
Sum of actual labor units and remaining labor units.
Sum of actual nonlabor cost and remaining nonlabor cost.
Sum of actual nonlabor units and remaining nonlabor units.
Planned total cost through activity completion; planned labor + planned nonlabor + planned expense cost.
Earned value minus actual cost of work performed.
EAC equals actual total cost plus estimate-to-complete cost; ETC method depends on the WBS earned-value technique.
Baseline planned material cost minus at-completion material cost.
Planned costs for all labor resources; when no resources are assigned, computed from planned labor units and default price/time.
Planned units for all labor resources assigned to the activity.
Sum of all material resource costs.
Planned costs for all nonlabor resources; when no resources are assigned, computed from planned nonlabor units and default price/time.
Planned units for all nonlabor resources assigned to the activity.
Planned labor cost + planned nonlabor cost + planned material cost + planned expense cost.
Sum of planned labor units and planned nonlabor units.
Baseline total cost scheduled to be completed as of the data date; computed as BAC × schedule percent complete.
Baseline labor units scheduled to be completed as of the data date; computed as baseline labor units × schedule percent complete.
